title: Grid loadingOverlayComponent name must match the key registered in getFrameworkComponents
answers: runs table loading overlay not rendering
where is the runs table loading spinner registered
how to change the runs table loading overlay
body:
Invariant: The ag-grid prop `loadingOverlayComponent` on the runs table is a string key that must match a key in the object returned by getFrameworkComponents() in experimentPage.column-utils.tsx.
Enforced at: ExperimentViewRunsTable.tsx:ExperimentViewRunsTable passes loadingOverlayComponent="loadingOverlayComponent" together with components={getFrameworkComponents()}.
What breaks if skipped: renaming one side without the other leaves the grid without a registered overlay, so the loading spinner stops appearing. The enzyme test reads getFrameworkComponents().loadingOverlayComponent directly, so it fails if the key is removed.
Constraints: Renaming the key requires updating both the table prop and the test; passing overlay-specific params is not required and the grid params are supplied by ag-grid itself.
applies: Changes to the runs table grid configuration or its framework component registry.
says: The loading spinner disappeared from the experiment runs table while fetching data.
No loading indicator appears on the experiment page when the runs list refreshes.
Restore the loading progress overlay on the tracking runs grid during data fetch.
The experiment runs view shows a blank grid instead of a loading animation.
Show a loading placeholder while the experiment run comparison table is updating.
search: The loadingOverlayComponent string key configured on ExperimentViewRunsTable.tsx must match the component key in getFrameworkComponents() from experimentPage.column-utils.tsx. A mismatch leaves the runs table grid without a registered loading overlay and causes enzyme tests targeting getFrameworkComponents().loadingOverlayComponent to fail. Any key rename requires updating both the runs table prop and the test.
